chunks: I call to witness the Day of Resurrection

key_terms.أُقْسِمُ: I swear / I call to witness

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of the oath by the Day of Resurrection in Surah Al-Qiyamah?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this oath underscores the absolute certainty of the Resurrection, serving as a rhetorical device to awaken the heedless from their spiritual slumber. It highlights the divine guarantee of accountability, reinforcing the concept of *Adl* (Divine Justice) where every soul will be recompensed for its deeds. This verse sets the theological foundation for the surah's subsequent descriptions of the fate of the righteous and the disbelievers.
